justification: Both surfaces include carved hieroglyphic inscriptions and figural imagery, but Panel A shows a specific scene with elongated human figures raising arms beneath a radiating sun disc over an offering table, while Panel B shows unrelated animal-like figures without any sun disc, offering table, or rays. The compositional scheme and specific iconographic elements (sun disc with rays, elongated figures, offering table with vessels) in A have no counterpart in B, which appears to depict different subject matter entirely.
